notes: «أنه سأل أبا عبدالله» : the asker هشام is a link, then the Imam he asked (rule 5, owner ruling 2); the Imam answers («فقال لي: يا هشام»), so he is the last link
«[388/2] الكافي:» is the quoted source label of al-Kafi, not a name
«قال هشام فوالله» is Hisham's own remark after the saying, not a link
